notes: MEC 013 Location: EdgeGuard uses /location/v3; the definition (3.1.1) declares https://localhost/location/v2
MEC 011 Application support: EdgeGuard uses /mec_app_support/v2; the definition (3.1.1) declares https://localhost:8081/mec_app_support/v1
spec_fixes: MEC021_AppMobilityService.yaml: AssociateId is a string placeholder 'as defined in MEC 012'; MEC 012 AssociateId used
MecAppSupportApi.yaml: confirm_ready defines no success response; 204 No Content added (GS MEC 011 clause 7.2.11.3.4)
MecServiceMgmtApi.yaml: changeType enum is the placeholder SEE_DESCRIPTION; the four values of its description used
RniAPI.yaml: 80 `type` keys next to `$ref` dropped (3.0 meaning of $ref)
